name: std/text
description: Combines, trims, and splits text using byte offsets and ASCII whitespace.
readme: Combines, trims, and splits text using byte offsets and ASCII whitespace.
Import this module with use text.

modules.name: std/text
modules.summary: Combines, trims, and splits text using byte offsets and ASCII whitespace.

items.name: concatenate
items.declaration: public use "text" function concatenate(left text, right text) giving failable text.

items.name: contains
items.declaration: public function contains(content text, value text) giving boolean.

items.name: ends
items.declaration: public function ends(content text, suffix text) giving boolean.

items.name: find
items.declaration: public use "text" function find(content text, value text) giving optional unsigned.

items.name: length
items.declaration: public use "text" function length(content text) giving unsigned.

items.name: release
items.declaration: public use "text" function release(content text) giving failable nothing.

items.name: slice
items.declaration: public use "text" function slice(content text, first unsigned, last unsigned) giving failable text.

items.name: split
items.declaration: public function split(content text, separator text) giving failable sequence of text.

items.name: starts
items.declaration: public function starts(content text, prefix text) giving boolean.

items.name: trim
items.declaration: public use "text" function trim(content text) giving failable text.
